summary: Verified the blob-based download fix on the deployed frontend (https://raptor-code-poc.preview.emergentagent.com). All 3 home-page DownloadButtons and the guide-modal download were captured with Playwright expect_download: exact filenames and exact byte sizes matched (codememory-chrome.zip=10290, codememory-vscode.vsix=19320, CodeMemory-user-guide.md=10338 x2). Busy state (label 'downloading…', disabled, data-download-state='busy') and error state (label 'retry download', data-download-state='err', sibling [data-testid=download-chrome-btn-error] showing 'download failed: simulated network failure') both verified. Backend contract confirmed via curl on localhost:8001 and public URL: ?dl=1 -> attachment disposition, no param -> inline, both 200 with content-length 10338. Regression: /api/health 200 {status:ok}; /api/tree?owner=synth&name=webframework returns exists=true with 52 nodes (>=50).

minor.issue: Return 404 (only /downloads/chrome and /downloads/vscode exist) - informational only; the frontend uses the correct paths.

critical_code_review_comments: downloadFile() reliably handles cross-origin + inline disposition; AbortController timeout and objectURL revoke are correct. No issues found in DownloadButton state machine.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Download flow fully green as of iteration 5. Playwright expect_download works against the preview origin; console logs '[downloadFile] <name> bytes=<n>' can be used to cross-check blob sizes. To test error state, monkey-patch window.fetch for URLs containing '/downloads/' right before click and restore after; err state auto-resets after 4s so wait >4.5s before next assertions.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: cross-origin <a href download> attribute is ignored by Chrome, so no file was saved. Blob + object-URL + programmatic click fix verified working; byte sizes served verbatim by backend.
